subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

KMC, LOF, MQI, NSL, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• (+1) is added to the position value of each first letter.
 
• (+2) is added to the position value of each second letter.
 
• (+3) is added to the position value of each third letter.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c87f8b4cd600b1cf2a61b7de2ac964289c8d73c50c9a9252d73034d4446b270e.png] 

Hence, **"OUO"** is the correct answer.
